text.description_html:
Acorn IPDBP, Hand Forged Iron Castle Door Pull

This is one sturdy door pull; and its strong spiral design is unique, which is probably why it is a favorite. It has a rustic feel from a time when a blacksmith would hand-forge hardware so that this hearty pulls exudes an old world charm onto any door. Acorn made, the IPDBP measures 12 inches high and has a black iron finish that looks like it comes straight from the old world.

Iron Art is a unique line of products created by using the techniques of the traditional forge. Each piece is fabricated with a rare craftsmanship reminiscent of a time when expert artisans, hammer in hand, transformed pure iron into simple yet functional designs. The result is individual works of art made in an old world style. We are proud to offer these high quality pieces to complement your home.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Specifications for the Acorn IPDBP Spiral Castle-Style Door Pull:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Height: 12"
  • Base Diameter: 2-3/4"
  • Projection: 2-7/8"

Sold individually. Package includes 1 pull and hardware for a surface mounted application (screws to the door's face). This Acorn Iron door pull is handmade and all dimensions are approximate.
